consistency_checks.identity_note: T7 was produced after the BASE-05 implementation change; this aggregate preserves that provenance distinction and does not treat T4/T5/T7 as byte-identical implementation runs.

phase1_security_conclusion: The Android baseline demonstrates a reproducible grant-enforce-revoke execution-authority lifecycle on the declared Pixel_7 Android 34 x86_64 application-runtime boundary.
claim_ceiling: Verified only for the declared Pixel_7 Android 34 x86_64 app-runtime boundary. This aggregate does not establish Android-wide security, SELinux enforcement, Binder enforcement, kernel enforcement, physical-device behavior, or all-Android-platform generalization.
measurement_boundary: Security semantics and bounded fixture effects only; performance, throughput, tail latency, CPU, memory, energy, and physical-device measurements remain outside this closure.
canonicality: This aggregate references immutable T4, T5, and T7 closure artifacts; it does not modify or replace them.
